disposition.reason: This docket is an enforcement action the Town of Georgia brought against the Kings for placing a second dwelling (a mobile trailer) without a permit; the Kings never appealed the notice of violation, so no municipal decision is under appeal. The only dispute is over penalties for a violation, not permission for new housing.

evidence.quote: The Town of Georgia (“Town”) has brought an enforcement action against Ronald King and Laurie King (“Defendants”)
Defendants did not appeal the issuance of the NOV.
On June 20, 2010, the Town instituted the present enforcement action against Defendants based on the violation alleged in the NOV.
leaving for trial only the question of what penalties should be assessed upon Defendants based on their violation of the Town’s zoning ordinance

judgments.note: Town-brought zoning enforcement action; the NOV was never appealed (doc 1 p2) and the trailer later received a certificate of occupancy as an accessory dwelling outside this docket. Remaining issue is penalties only.
Enforcement the town brought without an appeal of a municipal decision; GUIDE says no. References to 'this appeal' in doc 2 are loose wording for the enforcement proceeding.
Subject is a violation/penalty proceeding over an unpermitted second dwelling, not permission for new housing; NOV-related disputes are 'no' under the housing table.

history.note: Excluded: town zoning enforcement action over unappealed NOV; penalties only.
